summary: The three most important visible problems are: (1) severe skirt/body intersection in cross_legged, where both folded legs and shoes emerge through the front of the skirt; (2) raised thighs passing through the skirt in high_kick, kneel_one, deep_lunge and lie_back_elbows, with similar intersections in sit_chair and the seated portion of sit_stand; and (3) bulky sleeves merging into one another across the chest in arms_crossed and hug_self. Disabled cloth physics explains the skirt retaining its flared shape instead of settling around the legs, but the visible body-through-cloth intersections remain defects in these renders. Most standing, turning and overhead-arm poses preserve convincing body volume. No clear mesh explosions, tearing or reversed joints are visible. Clip ratings apply to the supplied samples; smooth interpolation and brief inter-frame defects cannot be fully assessed from contact sheets.

items.name: sit_chair
items.location: Upper thighs and front of skirt, especially in the 3/4 view
items.issue: The seated thighs emerge through the front skirt surface while the skirt continues below them; missing physics explains the rigid flare but not the visible intersection.

items.name: seiza
items.location: Folded legs beneath the front hem
items.issue: The skirt and petticoat remain bell-shaped around the folded legs, with a shoe partly swallowed by the hem in the 3/4 view, consistent with limited cloth-chain posing without physics.

items.name: kneel_one
items.location: Raised thigh at the front of the skirt
items.issue: The raised thigh visibly passes through the skirt panel instead of displacing it, leaving the dress hanging beneath and around the exposed leg.

items.name: cross_legged
items.location: Both folded legs across the lap and front skirt
items.issue: Both folded legs and their shoes cut deeply through the intact skirt front, producing a conspicuous interleaving of limbs, fabric and waist ribbons.

items.name: deep_lunge
items.location: Forward thigh and front skirt panel
items.issue: The forward thigh exits through the skirt surface well above the hem while the fabric retains its standing flare, creating a clear body-through-cloth intersection.

items.name: run_l
items.location: Lifted thigh beneath the front hem
items.issue: The raised thigh crowds the front petticoat and the hem stays unusually flat around it, although the body silhouette remains plausible and the missing cloth physics explains much of the stiffness.

items.name: run_r
items.issue: The raised thigh presses into the skirt underside with a cramped hem overlap, while the rest of the skirt remains rigidly flared without simulated draping.

items.name: jump_tuck
items.issue: The tucked thighs are crowded against a broad, shelf-like skirt underside with small ambiguous cloth overlaps, but no clear joint failure is visible at this scale.

items.name: high_kick
items.location: Raised thigh through the front skirt
items.issue: The kicking leg emerges directly through the middle of the skirt panel, clearly visible in both views, while the garment remains largely undeformed.

items.name: arms_crossed
items.issue: The inflated sleeves intersect across the chest and merge into a single broad mass without a convincing boundary or compression between the crossed arms.

items.name: hand_to_shoulder
items.location: Raised sleeve against the upper chest
items.issue: The raised sleeve retains a balloon-like volume against the chest with little apparent compression, creating a small crowded contact region without a clear body-joint defect.

items.name: hug_self
items.location: Crossed sleeves in front of the chest
items.issue: The sleeves visibly interpenetrate into a joined angular mass across the chest instead of compressing and maintaining a readable overlap.

items.name: lie_back_elbows
items.issue: Both forward-projecting thighs emerge through the skirt front while the skirt retains a downward bell shape, producing obvious cloth/body intersections in the reclined pose.

items.name: dance_heart
items.location: Hands against the crown and bangs
items.issue: The fingers are crowded into the crown and bangs with a small apparent hair intersection where the hands meet above the forehead.

items.name: run
items.location: Swinging knee and lower leg, most apparent in the 3/4 view
items.issue: The lifted knee opens and the foot drops noticeably across the adjacent samples, suggesting an abrupt leg transition that needs playback confirmation rather than showing a definite skinning collapse.

items.name: sit_stand
items.issue: The seated thighs pass through the front skirt surface while the skirt and petticoat hang beneath them; disabled physics explains the absent seat drape but the intersections are clearly visible.

items.name: idol_dance
items.location: Raised thigh and front skirt underside
items.issue: The raised thigh crowds the petticoat beneath a stiff flared hem, matching the small cloth-contact artifact in run_l, with no obvious pop between the two close samples.
